title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi set a new daily record:** Its 3.45B contracts on Oct. 3 were 39% above its seven-day average and topped the Sept. 27 high of 3.04B; sports, including parlays, made up 3.06B contracts, or 88.6% of the day’s total.
- **Novig broke above its recent range:** It traded 128.3M contracts on Oct. 3, more than double its seven-day average and above its previous 30-day high of 109.8M, for about a 3% market share.
- **Rothera sank below its recent range:** Its 8.4M contracts on Oct. 3 were 79% below its seven-day average and below its previous 30-day low, though the day amounted to only about 0.2% market share.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH venue_days AS (
    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US', 'ForecastEx', 'DKeX', 'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex', 'Novig', 'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'ProphetX', date, contracts
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE
),
latest AS (
    SELECT venue, MAX(report_date) AS report_date
    FROM venue_days
    GROUP BY venue
)
SELECT
    l.venue,
    l.report_date,
    MAX(v.contracts) FILTER (WHERE v.report_date = l.report_date) AS latest_contracts,
    AVG(v.contracts) FILTER (
        WHERE v.report_date < l.report_date
          AND v.report_date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    ) AS prior_30_day_daily_average,
    MIN(v.contracts) FILTER (
        WHERE v.report_date < l.report_date
          AND v.report_date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    ) AS prior_30_day_low,
    MAX(v.contracts) FILTER (
        WHERE v.report_date < l.report_date
          AND v.report_date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    ) AS prior_30_day_high,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE v.report_date < l.report_date
          AND v.report_date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    ) AS prior_30_day_reporting_days
FROM latest l
JOIN venue_days v ON v.venue = l.venue
GROUP BY l.venue, l.report_date
ORDER BY l.venue;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM category_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-10-03'
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT CAST(g.day AS DATE) AS date
    FROM latest l,
         generate_series(
             l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY,
             l.report_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY,
             INTERVAL 1 DAY
         ) AS g(day)
),
categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT kalshi_category
    FROM category_daily, latest
    WHERE date >= latest.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND date <= latest.report_date
      AND kalshi_category IS NOT NULL
      AND kalshi_category <> ''
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT
        c.kalshi_category,
        AVG(COALESCE(d.contracts, 0)) AS prior_30_day_daily_average
    FROM categories c
    CROSS JOIN calendar cal
    LEFT JOIN category_daily d
      ON d.kalshi_category = c.kalshi_category
     AND d.date = cal.date
    GROUP BY c.kalshi_category
)
SELECT
    l.report_date,
    d.kalshi_category,
    d.contracts AS latest_contracts,
    d.contracts * 100.0 / NULLIF(o.contracts_total, 0) AS share_of_kalshi_volume_pct,
    b.prior_30_day_daily_average,
    (d.contracts - b.prior_30_day_daily_average)
        / NULLIF(b.prior_30_day_daily_average, 0) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_30_day_average
FROM latest l
JOIN category_daily d ON d.date = l.report_date
JOIN daily_overall o ON o.date = l.report_date
JOIN baseline b ON b.kalshi_category = d.kalshi_category
WHERE d.kalshi_category IS NOT NULL
  AND d.kalshi_category <> ''
ORDER BY d.contracts DESC
LIMIT 20;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_days AS (
    SELECT 'Kalshi' AS venue, date AS report_date, contracts_total AS contract_volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE COALESCE(is_partial, FALSE) = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS contract_volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US', 'ForecastEx', 'DKeX', 'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex', 'Novig', 'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'ProphetX' AS venue, date AS report_date, contracts AS contract_volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'CME' AS venue, date AS report_date, cme_total_vol AS contract_volume
    FROM cme_daily
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        contract_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM venue_days
),
venue_summary AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        MAX(report_date) FILTER (WHERE recency_rank = 1) AS report_date,
        MAX(contract_volume) FILTER (WHERE recency_rank = 1) AS reported_contract_volume,
        AVG(contract_volume) FILTER (WHERE recency_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8) AS prior_seven_day_average
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY venue
)
SELECT
    venue,
    report_date,
    reported_contract_volume,
    prior_seven_day_average,
    (reported_contract_volume - prior_seven_day_average)
        / NULLIF(prior_seven_day_average, 0) * 100 AS percent_change_vs_prior_seven
FROM venue_summary
ORDER BY venue;
